overview.title: Overview
overview.emptyNote: Counts appear as members, suppliers, samples and orders arrive.

inventory.title: Sample inventory
inventory.note: Every unit on the shelf, from the master that never leaves to the ones out with members.
inventory.emptyNote: Units arrive with a container, are checked against the signed spec, then go on the shelf.

members.title: Members
members.note: Who has joined, who is waiting for review and whose plan needs attention.
members.emptyNote: A member appears the moment an ABN is submitted for review.

categories.title: Categories
categories.note: What members can browse, and the risk tier behind each one.
categories.emptyNote: A category needs a code and a risk tier before products can join it.

settings.title: Settings
settings.note: Every number the platform runs on: prices, rates, fees and the promises we make. Nothing here is hard-coded elsewhere.
settings.missingNote: One settings record holds every number; it needs to exist before it can be edited.

hubs.title: Hubs
hubs.note: {count} hubs taking samples. The first hub serves a member's state, the fallback rank decides which one is tried next.
hubs.notePlain: Who runs each hub, which states it serves first and which hub is tried next.
hubs.emptyNote: Brisbane and Sydney each need a manager and a fallback order.

containers.title: Containers
containers.note: {atSea} at sea, {landed} landed and waiting. {hub}, soonest ETA first.
containers.notePlain: What is at sea, what has landed and what is waiting on the broker.
containers.emptyNote: Sample consolidations arrive before the first order container.
containers.unpacked: Unpacked. Its units are in QC at the hub.

pipeline.title: Supplier pipeline
pipeline.note: {live} factories are live and {blocked} in the pipeline still have conditions to meet. Drag a card to move it; Live checks the conditions first.
pipeline.notePlain: Factories from the first screen through the visit and the film to a signed agreement.
pipeline.emptyNote: Pick another category, or clear the filter.

suppliers.title: Suppliers
suppliers.note: {total} factories on file, {live} live. A record holds the visit, the film, the checks and the money terms.
suppliers.notePlain: Every factory we work with, live and in progress.

products.title: Products
products.note: {total} products, {live} live. A product goes live once its spec is signed and a sample unit is on a shelf.
products.notePlain: The catalogue, its price tiers and the signed spec behind each one.

orders.title: Orders and inspections
orders.note: {total} orders, {needs} with a step waiting on us. Each step is taken in order.
orders.notePlain: Orders in production, in inspection and on the water.

order.title: Order
order.nextNote: Only the step after the current status runs; each one is added to the timeline.
order.cancelled: Second failed inspection: order cancelled, note added to refund the deposit.

actions.none: No next step. This order is closed.
actions.shippedNote: The container number and the route the goods take to the member.
actions.failedNote: The report link is kept on the order. A second failed inspection cancels it and refunds the deposit.

payouts.title: Supplier payouts
payouts.note: {count} payouts to send, {net} net. The balance carries our commission; the deposit does not.
payouts.notePlain: Deposits and balances, with our commission withheld from the balance.
payouts.statementNote: One supplier, one month, every order and its commission, summed from the rows.

queue.title: Sample requests
queue.findingSendAll: {count} to send today across both hubs

empty.awaiting: Nothing to send. New requests land here the moment a member asks.
empty.in_transit: No samples are on the road.
empty.deciding: No members are deciding right now.

labels.title: Dispatch labels
labels.emptyNote: Every request at this hub is out the door.

statement.title: Commission statement
statement.chooseFirstTitle: Choose a supplier and a month.
statement.chooseFirstNote: The statement lists each order's goods value and our commission.
statement.empty: No orders for this supplier in {month}.
statement.footnote: Commission is withheld from the balance payout. Figures are summed from the orders listed above.
